verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's AI-related evidence covers developer tooling: an MCP server for searching docs and managing test users and webhooks, a Claude Code plugin, and a prompt library for building integrations. None of it describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's own data inside the product. These are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit, so an applicable axis with no evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
